name: University of Michigan Center for Chemical Genomics: PHERAstar FSX plate reader (NIH S10; 2026)
brief: A high-throughput screening core replaces a 17-year-old and a 21-year-old multimode microplate reader with a single new multimode reader for fluorescence and luminescence assays.

cost.excludes_note: NIH S10 award for one reader; options, software, install and any institutional match are not itemised.

notes: Out-of-sample: found after the cost model was frozen at commit 02d7678 and scored blind against it (results in docs/validation.md). Later model or catalog changes do not count as out-of-sample for this case. price_basis=configured, from the wording of a grant to buy a working reader for a core facility (options not itemised). Verified 3 Oct 2026 via NIH RePORTER API (1S10OD038147-01A1, award_amount 155178; https://reporter.nih.gov/project-details/11337799). Quote: "seeks funding to support the purchase of a new microplate reader, the PHERAstar FSX." 1 of 1 items maps to bmg_pherastar_fsx (exact). Caveat: S10 award may differ from invoice.
